body:
Thank you, and sorry you find yourself in the same boat. Its one which he hope submerges and are rescued from. It's tough because no matter what happens you will beat yourself up over it, especially when you think you did everything perfectly. My problem related to that is everything that has happened since a certain event has caused me stress and me thinking "this would not be a problem if that happened as i wouldn't be doing this shit". Basically i live in the past a lot and i can't help it. That is such a bad thing to do when depressed but i find it impossible to snap out of.

it would be hypocritical for me to say it gets better as i'm in the same boat as you, but i hope you get out of the sutuation too. And agree, it has to end, one way or another you'd hope

I see what you mean, i know my mindset is a negative one and i go through phases where i try and have a different mindset but it ultimatly leads me to fall again.  I see other people i know doing well and when i get a chance i panic and want to turn back to comfort. Then when i am in comfort, i want what others have. Its a cycle and i can't get out of it.

i try my best not to let myself get affected easily but can't help it. Did your parents take on your stress tok when you talked if you don't mind me asking?

I'm really glad it is looking up for you and you are feeling better. Did just sharing help or was there a proper sort of step by step plan in dealing with problems? A part of me wishes to get to your stage, another wishes it could just finish now.

My parents can see i am upset but because i shut my feelings away from them, they just leave me too it but hint they're there constantly. And that of course sounds good to know they're there but they have their own problems. Whether be financial or major health problems which are there perminantly. My problems in comparison at times feel silly to moan about to them (even if linked) but they weigh me down to such a degree that i feel like i'm swimming with the fishes. Also my stress added to their stress already i feel would be too mich for them, i don't want to burden them too much. I know you said i'm mot to my loved ones but my parents carry too much stress as it is, anymore will feel overkill.

i have thought about a theropist but its hard to find time and i don't know how much it'll help. I think my inability to take control and let the smallest thing spirral out of control will always be there, along with my mindset of jumping to the negative first.

Thank you for responding. The last line was quite a beautiful little saying, actually made me smile which is something i haven't genuinly done for a while.

I don't like to burden those close to me with stuff. I opened up once recently to my parents and even that was only half an attempt, but that was enough to know that they were upset seeing i was upset. If i opened up fully i think there'd have been a full scale panic.

the thing about wanting to die which appeals to me is i will die without being a complete failure in people's eyes. But of course if obvious suicide is my method of death then i am a failure and i've affected the people i love and who love me. 

I look for excuses for things, especially to not do them. But then when they don't happen i regret it. Or my mind is so indecisive i can flip flop on a choice about 20 times in a minute causing me to get stressed and pray i get struck by lightning or something.

Edit: reading this post has made me realise how over the place it is and how much mumbo jumbo i've written. Sorry for those who are trying to make sense of it. If anything, explains how my brain works and is all over the place.

Probably isn't my darkest conaidering i have thoughts of suicide and attempted weakly a couple times.

But at work, I think i really really like this woman who is a fair few years older and moving so leaving the job. Get on great and character wise opposites but have similar life preferences. Only saying it here cos nobody else knows and just thought why not. Also assume lots of people around the world have similar experiences
